title: Every Ocean Animal That Kills in Its Own Way (Orca, Sperm Whale, Leopard Seal)
card: THE OCEAN HAS NO SAFE ZONE
intro: Doug has been hunted by an orca, followed a sperm whale into the abyss, and met a leopard seal under the ice. Then he went deeper, to where animals grow too big. Five trips, back to back. The ocean has never once been kind.
description: Five full episodes back to back: why orcas kill everything except Doug, how deep a sperm whale really dives, the leopard seal's ambush under the ice, why the deep sea grows giants, and what lives in every layer of the ocean. Real science, cartoon deaths.
